description: Quotes the POKT cost of one Pocket relay. POST /v1/estimate with compute_units_per_relay, compute_units_to_tokens_multiplier, compute_unit_cost_granularity, and optional relay_count returns a deterministic floor-division quote. POST /v1/network-status with network set to main or beta reads live public REST parameters and can attach a one-relay quote. Identical estimate inputs return identical bytes. Network status changes when chain parameters change, so the service is variable. Every response is a JSON object. The owner share uses ROYALTY_RATE and is a configured estimate, not live chain state.

rpc_types.backend_hint: relay-quote container on port 8080, private behind the HA RelayMiner rest backend
rpc_types.notes: GET /, HEAD /, GET /v1/version, GET /v1/health, POST /v1/estimate, and POST /v1/network-status. Responses use identity encoding and start with {. Inputs are JSON bodies. Do not set sync_check.

specs.notes: Moving branch URL. Add sha256 only after a tag freezes this file.

serving.backend: Run the relay-quote image on a private Docker network. Point the HA RelayMiner rest backend at http://backend:8080. No caller credential is required. Do not publish port 8080 on the public internet.
serving.notes: Backend limit is 1 MiB. Gateway: type passthrough, rpc_types rest, relay budget 30s. Health checks must match this card. Royalty is not a live parameter.
